sources_considered.why: Reports that OpenAI has not called any public model AGI as of about late summer 2026, and notes the independent panel mechanism.
Labeled satire by the publisher; not evidence.

receipt.public_excerpt: None of those announcements characterised GPT-5.6 or another publicly available model as AGI.

evidence_items.explanation: Interim context: as of about late summer 2026, OpenAI had not called any public model AGI. This is mid-horizon and cannot settle a forecast running to the end of 2027. The publication date is approximate; the page shows no date.

unresolved_gaps: The deadline (end of 2027) is after the evaluation date.
A satire piece refers to a reported September 2026 'AGI has arrived' post by Nvidia's CEO. I did not verify this, and a single executive's statement would not meet the broad-acceptance rule.
No independent verification panel ruling on AGI was found.
